title: Demonstration after fatal Garda shooting of George Nkencho

occurrence.summary: Three accessible reports identify the Dec31 gathering.

attendance_threshold.summary: Irish Times estimates around 200; Q102 and LMFM report over 100.

state_target.summary: Calls for arrest of shooting officer and regular GSOC investigation updates; Irish Times reports justice/transparency and suspension calls.

trigger.summary: The fatal shooting was by members of the Garda Armed Support Unit on Dec30; it preceded the demonstration.

end_and_continuity.summary: Article says attendees committed to continuing protest outside station for next 14 days; this gathering’s own ending and January follow-up unverified.

title: Anti-mask / anti-restrictions protest on Cork Grand Parade
location: Grand Parade to RTÉ Cork offices / Taoiseach constituency office, Cork

occurrence.summary: Later court report records Garda testimony that protest took place Dec12.

attendance_threshold.summary: No count in accessible Irish Examiner report; RTÉ exact page 403.

state_target.summary: Anti-mask speakers called Covid a hoax and alleged RTÉ relayed government lies; route included Taoiseach office, but crowd demand framing needs contemporaneous corroboration.

source_temporality.summary: Evidence is a 2022 court report, not contemporaneous 2020 coverage.
